children: The Bank of Thailand is likely to look through the latest pick up in inflation and hold its policy rate steady later this month, Barclays economists say in a note. Headline CPI rose 2.82% on year in September, slightly higher than August's 2.53% increase. The latest print was also below Barclay's 3.2% forecast. "Today's lower​-​than​-​expected CPI is likely to offer comfort to the BOT at the margin," they say. Despite an acceleration in inflation, the BOT has previously stated its preference to look through temporary energy and food price shocks, they note.(amanda.lee@wsj.com)
